title: Cases that pin down a crew rule
heading: Pair Every Refused Plan With an Allowed One, at the Boundary
cases: every case's verdict is the correct rule's, and the cases hold at least one allowed and one refused plan
a plan that uses every crew-month of a year is allowed, so a rule written as one month short fails it
a plan over the crews only in the plan's last year is refused, so a loop that stops a year early fails it
a job that works over two years fits month by month but not with all its months charged to its start year
